records.notes: kb/Work PB232 (wave 56): optional item, Not provided - no entry-convention-name is defined; COBOL is the one convention and the default (GR4 c). A named convention is COBOL2385. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/OptionsBinder.cs#EntryConventionOf (kb/Work PB298: the ENTRY-CONVENTION screen returns nothing now that the clause has no model field, so EntryConventionOf became ScreenEntryConvention (the same SR1 + GR3 checks, COBOL2385)) || editions corrected from 2014,2023 to 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3322, the refuter pass over kb/Work PB3173's S0b decisions): the item documents the entry-convention-names, their meanings and the default when none is specified, and ISO/IEC 1989:2002 already carries all three: §2002:11.8.5.3 GR2 (the ENTRY-CONVENTION clause IS entry-convention-name-1: the meaning of the named convention is implementor-defined) and the unnumbered default paragraph of §2002:11.8.5.3, and lists the item as §2002:B.1 item 44 (the implementor-defined language element list; optional, citing 11.8.5 general rule 2). The 2014 introduction is only the COBOL alternative of the format (the construct options-entry-convention-2014); the item's referents are 2002's. PB3173 read the clause as a 2014 introduction from that construct's id.
